episodes.synopsis: A Touka Scott non importa molto dei demoni che stanno devastando il mondo... finché una visita del leggendario eroe non cambia tutto.
episodes.title: L'eroe è morto?!

episodes.synopsis: Il gruppo del nuovo eroe parte per una missione di caccia ai demoni, ma sorgono domande sulle motivazioni di Kyle.
episodes.title: Il falso eroe

episodes.synopsis: Il gruppo arriva nella capitale reale nella speranza di ottenere dei soldi, ma Touka dovrà prima imparare a superare le sfide del suo nuovo corpo...
episodes.title: L'eroe è uno scheletro!

episodes.synopsis: Touka passa la giornata insieme alla principessa, mentre un sinistro complotto si mette in moto sotto la capitale.
episodes.title: La sposa e l'eroe

episodes.synopsis: Touka e il suo gruppo improvvisato affrontano il vero terrore che infesta la capitale.
episodes.title: L'eroe rinato

episodes.synopsis: Uno strano incantesimo che trasforma i cittadini in mostri impone al gruppo dell'eroe alcune decisioni difficili.
episodes.title: L'eroe è una donna

episodes.synopsis: Mentre Touka e i suoi amici inseguono l'entità che rende zombie i cittadini, un incontro con un altro gruppo di avventurieri solleva nuove domande.
episodes.title: Un nuovo eroe

episodes.synopsis: I malvagi negromanti assoldano un letale mercenario per rallentare il gruppo, mentre emergono nuove rivelazioni sul passato di Touka.
episodes.title: L'eroe è un apprendista!

episodes.synopsis: Touka si risveglia in un luogo familiare: è il passato? È un sogno? Qualunque cosa sia, dovrà risolvere il mistero prima che scada il tempo per lui e Yuna!
episodes.title: L'eroe è nel passato

episodes.synopsis: Il gruppo del leggendario eroe raggiunge finalmente Elvania, mentre il re cerca di fermare il complotto dei negromanti.
episodes.title: L'eroe si infiltra

episodes.synopsis: È arrivato il momento della battaglia decisiva. Riuscirà Touka a sconfiggere Diego e salvare Yuna prima che scada il tempo?!
episodes.title: L'eroe combatte!

episodes.synopsis: La situazione è terribile e Touka continua a non svegliarsi, anche se il tempo sta per scadere.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Tre anni fa un eroe ha sigillato un cancello dell'inferno, ma il sigillo si è indebolito molto da allora, e sporadicamente lascia passare dei mostri. Dopo che un grande gruppo di mostri è entrato nel paese attraversando il cancello dell'inferno, la professione di eroe è diventata di nuovo indispensabile. Touka Scott, un piccolo agricoltore della città di Cheza, si è preparato per un improvviso attacco di mostri. Ha costruito una trappola in cui attirarli nel caso di un eventuale attacco al villaggio. Improvvisamente un mostro attacca e Touka prova invano ad attirarlo in trappola usando della pancetta affumicata. Fortunatamente l'eroe locale salva il villaggio appena in tempo. Dopo aver sconfitto il mostro, l'eroe, affamato, tenta di mangiare un boccone di pancetta, ma muore cadendo nella trappola di Touka. Dopo aver causato la morte dell'eroe locale, Touka è costretto a prendere il suo posto, per proteggere la regione dall'attacco dei mostri.
info.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!

info.synopsis: Sato è un normale impiegato a cui un giorno gli viene affidato il compito di fare da tutor al figlio del direttore in cambio di una alta posizione all'interno dell'azienda. Il bambino si chiama Ichiro Matsushita, un piccolo genio con intenti misteriosi. Sato indagando scopre che prima di lui c'era già stato un tutor, ma non si sapeva che fine avesse fatto. Il ragazzo in realtà è "Akuma-kun" esperto nella magia nera che trasforma il suo tutor in un uomo lucertola rendendolo suo servitore. Il suo obiettivo è quello di aprire un portale fra il mondo degli umani e quello dei demoni, per evocare potenti mostri che lo aiutino a conquistare il mondo.
info.title: Akuma Kun (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: 勇者が魔王を倒してから、魔王の支配から逃れたモンスターたちはデルムリン島で平和に暮らしていた。そこで育った唯一の人間・ダイは今日も魔法使いになる修行をしていたが、そこにニセ勇者一行が現れ、ダイの親友であるゴールデンスライムをさらってしまい…。
episodes.title: Sono un piccolo prode

episodes.synopsis: パプニカの姫レオナがその従者のテムジン、バロンと共にデルムリン島を訪れた。この島でパプニカ王国の後継者になるための儀式を行うというのだ。だが、ダイが儀式の場所である地の穴に案内する途中、島にはいなかったモンスター・魔のサソリに襲われる。
episodes.title: La principessa Lilibeth

episodes.synopsis: 毒に冒されたレオナ姫を救うべく洞窟の出口を探すダイ。一方地上では勇者を殺すために作られたというキラーマシーンが姿を現す。なんとか地上に出たダイだが、レオナを救う頼みの綱であるブラスを殺されそうになる。その時、謎の紋章がダイの額に浮かびあがる。
episodes.title: Il segno del Drago

episodes.synopsis: 各地でモンスターが暴れはじめ、デルムリン島のモンスターたちも凶暴になるものが出はじめた。どうやら魔王が復活を遂げたらしい。そんな中、デルムリン島に、勇者の家庭教師を名乗るアバンと、その弟子ポップがダイを一人前の勇者にするために現れて…
episodes.title: Avan, il maestro dei prodi

episodes.synopsis: アバンの指導のもとに修行を始めるダイ。その目覚しい成長によって、初歩の剣技である大地斬を習得する。だが、次にアバンはダイに対して命がけの特訓を強いる。自らが竜に変身する呪文ドラゴラムを唱えてダイを追い詰め、新しい剣技を習得させようというのだ。
episodes.title: L'allenamento speciale di Tom

episodes.synopsis: 命がけの特訓により、炎や波など形のないものを斬る技、海波斬のコツをつかみはじめるダイ。だが、その時、デルムリン島の結界を破り、侵入する者がいた。かつて勇者に倒された魔王ハドラーが復活し、島に襲来したのだ。果たしてその真意とは…!?
episodes.title: Il grande Haddler

episodes.synopsis: ハドラーの圧倒的な力に、かつて勇者だったアバンと言えどもなす術がない。弟子としてアバンを援護しようとするダイだが、到底ハドラーの力には及ばない。弟子たちを守り、ハドラーを倒すために、アバンはある呪文を唱える
episodes.title: Haddler contro Avan

episodes.synopsis: アバンの決死の覚悟も通用せず、ハドラーに圧倒される。だが、アバンは自己を犠牲にした破壊呪文、メガンテの隙をうかがっていたのだ。一帯を吹き飛ばすほどの威力の呪文が発動する。はたしてアバンの命は？　そしてハドラーを倒すことはできたのか？
episodes.title: Il sacrificio di Avan

episodes.synopsis: 師を失ったポップとダイは、デルムリン島を旅立つ準備をはじめる。一緒に暮らしたモンスターたちとの別れの時が迫る。一方、傷つき拠点に帰還したハドラーは、ダイを脅威と認め、大魔王バーンによって与えられた魔王軍の力で討ち取る決意を固めていた。
episodes.title: Addio Dermlin

episodes.synopsis: 冒険の手始めに、ロモス王に会うべく王宮に向かう途中、魔の森をさまようダイとポップ。途中で出会った魔法銃を使う少女マァムとポップがケンカになり、魔の森から出られない。そんな中、百獣魔団・軍団長の一人クロコダインに、ハドラーよりダイ討伐の命が下る
episodes.title: Drakon, il Re della foresta

episodes.synopsis: ダイの前にクロコダインが姿を現す。ハドラー以上の怪力と、バギ呪文の効果を備える真空のオノの前に苦戦するダイ。クロコダインに恐れをなしてポップはその場を逃げ出していたが、途中マァムに会い、共にダイの元に向かう。
episodes.title: La spada di Avan

episodes.synopsis: アバンから教えを受け、魔弾銃を渡されたマァム。彼女の作戦により、クロコダインは斧を封じられ、手痛い反撃を受けて撤退していった。3人が無事ネイルの村に着き、ゴメちゃんと合流。5年ほど前アバンが村を訪れた時のことを語り合うマァムとダイたちだったが…。
episodes.title: La pistola magica

episodes.synopsis: 村の長老に魔法の手ほどきを受けた後、ネイルの村を旅立つことを決めたダイたち。ポップはマァムを誘わないかとダイにもちかける。妖魔司教ザボエラが、クロコダインにダイ打倒の策を授ける。卑怯な手を嫌うクロコダインだが、ダイに敗れた雪辱を果たそうと…。
episodes.title: La trappola

episodes.synopsis: ロモスに総攻撃のために進撃するクロコダインと百獣魔団のモンスターたち。ロモス城の危機を知ったダイは、仲間たちを宿に置いたまま飛び出してします。ダイの後を追うのをこばむポップを殴りつけ、マァムもロモス城に向かう。そして残されたポップは…。
episodes.title: L'esercito degli animali all'attacco

episodes.synopsis: ダイの強くなる速さに驚いたクロコダインは、ザボエラより渡された“切り札”を使うことにした。魔法の筒から現れたのは、ダイの育ての親、鬼面導士のブラスだった。動揺して攻撃できないダイに対し、容赦なく魔法を使うブラス。そこにマァムが駆けつけるが…。
episodes.title: Nonno Ubaldo attacca Tom

episodes.synopsis: ダイは、クロコダインの持つ魔法の筒に再びブラスを閉じ込める作戦を考える。だが、クロコダインの放った獣王痛恨撃によって窮地に陥るダイ。そして動きを封じられてマァムも援護できない。ニセ勇者一行の魔法使いまぞっほが、その様子をポップに伝えると…。
episodes.title: Forza Daniel

episodes.synopsis: 臆病なポップがダイの窮地を救うために、勇気をふりしぼりクロコダインに立ち向かう。切り札の呪文は防がれ、クロコダインになす術なく踏みつけられるポップだが、ボロボロになりながら、ダイを救うため、そして奇跡の逆転のために、ある魔法を発動させる。
episodes.title: La forza dell'amicizia

episodes.synopsis: ポップの捨て身の行動に助けられ、魔王軍の卑劣なやり方に怒りに燃えるダイの額に紋章が輝く。負けるわけにはいかないクロコダインも、必殺の獣王痛恨撃の体勢に入る。剣を手にしていないダイを援護するべく、マァムはポップに回復呪文ホイミをかける！
episodes.title: Il piccolo eroe

episodes.synopsis: ブラスとの別れをせず、パプニカに渡る船に乗っていたダイ。だが、レオナ姫のいるパプニカには、魔王軍の不死身の軍隊が送られていると知り、闘志を燃やす。一方ハドラーは拠点の鬼岩城に全軍団を集結させ一丸となってダイを叩こうとするが…。
episodes.title: Una brutta sorpresa

episodes.synopsis: モンスターに破壊されたパプニカ城の跡地で出会った剣士、それはかつてアバンに剣を教わったヒュンケルという青年だった。だが、その頃、ハドラーの拠点でも同じ名前が口にされていた。不死騎団長ヒュンケルに、大魔王バーンより直々に討伐の指令がくだったと。
episodes.title: Nemesis lo spadaccino

episodes.synopsis: 最強の鎧と剣を身につけ、アバンの剣技をつかう不死騎団長ヒュンケル。強大な実力を前になす術のないダイたち。ヒュンケルは語る。魔王が討たれたために育ての親であるアンデッドモンスターを失った。その仇をうつためにアバン本人に弟子入りしたのだと。
episodes.title: La spada del male

episodes.synopsis: 強敵ヒュンケルに対して、ダイたちの魔法も攻撃も通じない。そして、ヒュンケルと同じように、モンスターに育てられたダイは、どうしても紋章の力を発揮することができない。暗黒闘気により動きが封じられたダイに、絶体絶命の危機が迫る！
episodes.title: La mano del Diavolo

episodes.synopsis: ダイたちを取り逃がしたヒュンケルは、かつてハドラーの本拠地だった地底魔城でハドラーの来訪を受ける。一方捕らえられたマァムを取り戻すために、ポップとダイはヒュンケルに通じる攻撃方法を考えていた。
episodes.title: Mara è in pericolo

episodes.synopsis: マァムを助けるために潜入した地底魔城で、闘技場におびきだされてしまうダイとポップ。雨雲を呼ぶ呪文と雷の呪文ライデインを組み合わせてヒュンケルを倒そうとするが、ヒュンケルが肝心の剣を抜かない。一方、マァムは牢を抜け出そうと…。
episodes.title: Il labirinto mortale

episodes.synopsis: ダイとポップの連係技により大ダメージを受けたヒュンケルだが、その威力に耐えて立ち上がり、ダイの動きを封じた上、必殺のブラッディースクライドを放つ。その直後、闘技場にマァムが現れる。ヒュンケルの育ての親バルトスが残した遺言をもって…。
episodes.title: Grazie per il dolce ricordo

episodes.synopsis: ダイが立ち上がり、ヒュンケルに対して、意識のないまま剣と魔法を組み合わせた攻撃を放ち鎧を破壊していく。必殺技を放とうとするヒュンケルに対して、まだ残る雨雲を見たポップは稲妻を呼べと叫ぶ。ダイはライデインと剣の合体技を決めることはできるのか!?
episodes.title: Il guerriero solitario

episodes.synopsis: パプニカ城の兵士バダックの情報により信号弾をあげてレオナ姫を捜す手がかりをつかもうとするダイたち。ダイが火炎大地斬を放って火薬に引火させてしまうが、なんとか信号弾があがる。パプニカ王国の気球船に乗っていたある人物がその信号弾に気づき…。
episodes.title: Operazione salvare Lilibeth

episodes.synopsis: レオナ姫とパプニカ国三賢者のうちアポロとマリンは、氷炎将軍フレイザードに襲撃され、危機に陥っていた。炎や氷の呪文は吸収され、強力な呪文で反撃されてしまう。そこにダイたちが駆けつけ、習得したばかりの魔法剣で攻撃するが…。
episodes.title: Il Signore delle Fiamme di Ghiaccio

episodes.synopsis: 氷炎結界を発動させ、自分以外の者の力を低下させて猛威をふるうフレイザード。レオナは撤退を決意するが、フレイザードが彼女を禁呪で氷づけにしてしまう。姫を残し、気球で逃れることで全滅をまぬがれようとする一同。そこにフレイムの大群が襲いかかる！
episodes.title: Una statua di ghiaccio

episodes.synopsis: かつて勇者アバンと共に戦ったという魔導師マトリフと出会った一同。事情を語り、結界を破壊する準備の傍ら、レオナ奪還のためにポップはマトリフのもとで修行し、ダイも目隠しで特訓を重ねる。だが、そうしている内にもレオナの生命力は失われていた…。
episodes.title: L'allenamento speciale del mago Matlif

episodes.synopsis: ポップも修行を終え、レオナ奪還を目指してバルジ島に上陸するダイたち。だが、結界の塔破壊のために戦力を分けるタイミングを狙い、ハドラーも超竜軍団をのぞく全軍を動かしていた。ダイの前にはザボエラと二つの軍団が、そしてポップとマァムの前には…。
episodes.title: L'isola di Balgar

episodes.synopsis: 妖魔軍団と魔影軍団に単身苦戦を続けるダイ。だが、そこに心強い味方、クロコダインが現れる。一方、ハドラーを前に、奮戦かなわずポップもマァムも窮地に陥っていた。クロコダインによれば、こちらにも心強い援軍が現れるはずだが…。
episodes.title: Il salvatore immortale

episodes.synopsis: ポップとマァムの前に姿を現したヒュンケル。クロコダインによって、死の寸前で救われ、自分の罪を償うために、同じアバンの使徒としてダイたちに力を貸す決意をしたという。ヒュンケルとハドラーが対峙する中、ポップたちはダイと合流し…。
episodes.title: Il ritorno di Nemesis

episodes.synopsis: ハドラーの呪文に瀕死になりながら、自分の全生命力を注ぎ込んだ技・グランドクルスでハドラーに反撃するヒュンケル。その想いを胸に、ダイもレオナ救出のために塔に急ぐ。だが、その様子を眺めていたフレイザードは不敵に笑う。ダイたちを待ち受けるのは…!?
episodes.title: L'incredibile Grande Croce

episodes.synopsis: ダイたちに加えて、クロコダイン、ヒュンケルが合流。氷炎将軍フレイザードに立ち向かう。だが、フレイザードは、自らの身体を爆発させた後、その硬い岩石のような体を操って攻撃をしかけてきた。ダイたちは弾丸のような無数の岩石に傷だらけになっていく。
episodes.title: Lotta all'ultimo sangue

episodes.synopsis: フレイザードを倒すためには、見えない悪を斬る空裂斬しかない。ダイの空裂斬は完全に成功しないながらも、わずかながらフレイザードの核をかすめつつあった。一方、ヒュンケルに倒されたはずのハドラーは、ミストバーンの暗黒闘気により復活を遂げていた…。
episodes.title: La tecnica di Avan

episodes.synopsis: ダイに魔力の核を破壊され、体を保つことができないフレイザード。そこにミストバーンが現れ、魔影軍団最強の鎧を与える。最強の鎧と一体になったフレイザードは、呪文もきかない強力な体で暴れはじめるが、ダイは負ける気がしないとフレイザードに向かう。
episodes.title: L'attacco di Avan

episodes.synopsis: 勝利の宴の後、ヒュンケルたちは鬼岩城に偵察に向かう。レオナ姫を救出した際に壊れた魔弾銃はもう修理ができない。そして、レオナの回復呪文の力や、ポップが魔法の腕をあげているの見て、マァムは考えごとをしていた。
episodes.title: La vittoria e le decisioni di Mara

episodes.synopsis: ハドラーの前に、大魔王バーン直属の殺し屋・キルバーンが現れる。本拠地をバーンの力で移動させるのだという。そのやりとりの中、魔竜軍団の竜騎将バランがハドラーにダイとの直接対決を求める。一方、マァムは武術の修行するためにダイたちと別れることに。
episodes.title: Arrivederci Mara

episodes.synopsis: 新たな装備を探すダイとポップ。だが、ダイがドラゴンの騎士だと悟ったマトリフは、ダイの力になれよと、とっておきの装備をポップに与える。その後、レオナも城を抜け出し、3人で買物のためにベンガーナ王国に向かうことに。
episodes.title: Strani acquisti

episodes.synopsis: 買物のために訪れていたベンガーナ。たくさんの人でにぎわう街に、突如ドラゴンの軍団が出現し、大暴れをはじめる。ドラゴンの被害から人々をかばいながら戦うダイたちだが、ヒドラに挑んだダイの剣が折れてしまう。
episodes.title: L'esercito dei Super draghi

episodes.synopsis: 竜の紋章の力を発動させ、ヒドラを倒したダイに対し、周囲の人間は恐れを抱いていた。ダイの力を見極めたキルバーンは去り、静寂が戻る中、竜の騎士の伝説を知るナバラとメルルがダイに話しかける、彼女たちの故郷・テランにその秘密を解く鍵があるという。
episodes.title: Il misterioso Regno di Teran

episodes.synopsis: ダイの前に超竜軍団長、竜騎士バランが現れ、人間を滅ぼすのに力を貸せと迫る。竜の騎士とは、魔族、竜、人間の力を持ち、過ちを犯した種族を滅ぼす役目の者。バランはその力でダイたちを圧倒し、ダイを連れ去ろうとする。バランの語るさらに衝撃の事実とは…!?
episodes.title: La vera identità di Tom

episodes.synopsis: 父と知りながら、バランに向かうダイ。それを遠くから見つめる大魔王バーンとその配下。アバンストラッシュも通じないバランに対して、ライデインと剣の合わせ技ライデインストラッシュを放つが、バランはさらにそれを上回る技を放とうと…。
episodes.title: Lotta tra padre e figlio

episodes.synopsis: ダイを回復させる間、助っ人として現れたクロコダインが奮戦。だが、その攻撃はバランの竜闘気により全て防がれてしまう。視力を奪われたクロコダインを見て、みかねたポップがバランに向かおうとするが、それを制止するクロコダイン。
episodes.title: Vita in pericolo

episodes.synopsis: ダイを支える力を奪うために、ダイの紋章の力を利用するバラン。ダイの思い出を全て消してしおうとする。だが、これまで出会った人々との絆がダイに力を与え、バランに匹敵するまでにその力が高められ…。
episodes.title: La strada è lunga

info.synopsis: Sono trascorsi ormai tredici anni dalla sconfitta del Re dei Demoni Hadler per mano dell'eroe Aban. Dai, un orfano di dodici anni cresciuto su un'isola popolata da mostri pacifici, sogna di diventare anche lui un valoroso eroe. Un giorno, come ricompensa per aver salvato una principessa in visita sull'isola da un tentativo di assassinio, Dai riceve finalmente il privilegio di essere allenato da Aban in persona, ma durante l'addestramento Aban viene attaccato da Hadler, ritornato in vita grazie alla magia oscura del Grande Satana Baan. Nemmeno sacrificando la sua vita Aban riesce a fermare Hadler e solo il risveglio di un misterioso potere di Dai costringe il Re dei Demoni a battere in ritirata. Questi tragici eventi segnano l'inizio del viaggio di Dai per vendicare la morte di Aban, sconfiggere l'esercito demoniaco e riportare la pace nel mondo.

info.synopsis: Per il nuovo lungometraggio animato dedicato al celebre gatto spaziale Doraemon, la storia si baserà sul romanzo de L'Isola del Tesoro di Robert Louis Stevenson. Doraemon, Nobita, Shizuka, Gian e Suneo partono per un avvenuta nel mar dei Caraibi. È il capitano di una nave e si ritrova a dover combattere dei pirati che hanno eseguito un arrembaggio. Shizuka viene rapita e una tempesta impedisce l’inseguimento dei rapitori. I robot Mini-Dora aiutano Nobita e la sua ciurma durante le ricerche; durante le quali si imbattono nell’isola del tesoro, che si rivelerà essere molto più che un’ordinaria isola…

episodes.synopsis: Bird Kazami is an amateur blader who came to "X City" to become a professional beyblader.
episodes.title: X

episodes.synopsis: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.
episodes.title: Multi-Colored Ambush

episodes.synopsis: After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.
episodes.title: Team Persona

episodes.synopsis: Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.
episodes.title: Bey Sponsor

episodes.synopsis: Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.
episodes.title: To the X

episodes.synopsis: Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon and Multi set off to Lions Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, to see if they could gather any intel.
episodes.title: Lion`s Jungle

episodes.synopsis: It's Team Persona's debut match, they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.
episodes.title: Team Zooganic

episodes.synopsis: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each; it has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.
episodes.title: The Mask and the King

episodes.synopsis: After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.
episodes.title: Beycrafter

episodes.synopsis: Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread, with their upcoming match with Team Persona their last chance to stay in the limelight.
episodes.title: The Pro Realm

episodes.synopsis: After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.
episodes.title: Warden`s Exam

episodes.synopsis: Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches in which Bladers showcase their individual personalities and skills.
episodes.title: The Final Battle

episodes.synopsis: With all eyes on the mysterious Blader X and the multi-talented Multi Nana-iro, Robin's losing streak starts to weigh on his confidence, until he finds his first fan.
episodes.title: The First Fan

episodes.synopsis: Recently, feeling a lack of tension and noticing laxity in Ekusu, Meiden orders specialized training at the Blader Gym. If Ekusu completes the training menu, there's a bonus of Meiden personally becoming the opponent in a Beybattle. Presented with a case containing various Beys, Ekusu's excitement reaches its peak! The prepared menu includes strength training, running, and even swimming, unrelated to battles. Meiden emphasizes that this training is not just for Ekusu but also for Bird...
episodes.title: Jax-ercise

episodes.synopsis: The invitation to the new sensation theme park "Zonamos House," where you can enjoy both the bey and riddles simultaneously, has been extended to the influencer, Multi. In the most popular 4X attraction, "Riddles and Bey," numerous riddles and battles with unknown creatures await, challenging Bird's Team Persona. They collaborate to overcome various challenges, ultimately reaching a mysterious figure who presents further riddles to Persona!
episodes.title: Riddles and Beys

episodes.synopsis: In the main attraction of Zonamos House, "Riddles and Beys," the Persona who cleared numerous riddles faces further challenges from Zonamos, the caretaker of Zonamos House. Despite struggling to solve the riddles that started with the cry "Do it!" by Kamen X and Bird, Multi notices something while watching their battle. Although it's said that no one has ever cleared "Riddles and Beys" before, can Persona overcome it?
episodes.title: Noblesse Oblige

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious Bey scattered throughout X City. By the time Bird became aware of its existence, it had already fallen into the hands of many bladers. The power of amateur bladers wielding it rivaled that of professionals, and even the shots fired by innocent children in battle were moving at speeds beyond the eye's ability to track with that Bey. Bird, witnessing this phenomenon everywhere, was astonished. The mysterious Bey boasting overwhelming speed enveloped X City...!!
episodes.title: Bey Timeshift

episodes.synopsis: Due to declining popularity, the professional status of Phalanx is in jeopardy as they prepare for their third showdown. At the behest of sponsors, all members of Phalanx were seen using the mysterious Bey that's been the talk of the city. As they climb X Tower with consecutive victories, they once again stand before Persona! Will Ishiyama and his team, determined to win at all costs to secure a permanent sponsor, come at them?
episodes.title: Pride

episodes.synopsis: Persona participates as a guest in the "DATTO" event hosted by Zooganic's King Manju. Bird is mistaken for an amateur participant for some reason and ends up joining on the run side! Throughout various locations, Beybattles unfold, with some amateur bladers even using the mysterious Bey that's the talk of X City. As the finale approaches, even the seasoned pro bladers begin to show signs of fatigue. Amidst both pros and amateurs dropping out, who manages to stay until the very end...!?
episodes.title: Zip and Zoom

episodes.synopsis: Bird discovers a talent outside of Beyblade! His amazing skills for sushi-making end up reminding former top player Ekusu of his past...
episodes.title: Memories of Sushi

episodes.synopsis: "Stop neglecting your appearance so much!" scolded by Multi, Ekusu and Bird were taken to the Blader-exclusive apparel shop "Bladers Dress" to tidy up. While Bird was looking for clothes in the store, a person introducing themselves as the Ambassador told him that he lacked charm as a pro Blader. Furthermore, when told that the shoot for measuring Blader characteristics was "disappointing", Bird, unsatisfied, challenges to a battle...!
episodes.title: Pop Production

episodes.synopsis: The next battle has already been set to be against the formidable newly formed Team Yggdrasil! As Nekoyama Zonamos and Namba Yuni step onto the stage, the tension rises up and beyond. That, however, is nothing compared to when their leader...
episodes.title: Black and White

episodes.synopsis: The second battle between Team Ygdrassil and Team Persona commences! As Nanairo Multi and Namba Yuni fight, the latter proposes to bet on their influencer careers...
episodes.title: True Heart

episodes.synopsis: As the final battle with Team Yggdrasil closes in, their leader Fujiwara Burn finally arrives with a beyblade that seems to surpass its predecessor, Phoenix Feather, which has caused chaos within X City..!
episodes.title: Arrival of the Fastest

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Persona and Yggdrasil that will determine the team's victory or defeat has finally begun. Kamen X launches his signature Extreme Dash attack, but Burn responds with a confident smile, ready to face it head-on! Despite using his greatest weapon, speed, Kamen X is surpassed by Burn and finds himself in a tight spot. Can Kamen X emerge victorious in the battle against Burn, who has triggered "Bey Time Shift"?! What will be the fate of Persona's team survival?!
episodes.title: Proof of the Fastest

episodes.synopsis: The "Shuffle Battle Festival" begins, the rules of which demand existing teams to be broken up and for each member to be assigned to a new one! During this event, however, the winners are not chosen by their amount of victories or losses, but their popularity..?!
episodes.title: Invitation

episodes.synopsis: As Byrd passes by the amateur arena, he hears abuse. For some reason, Ishiyama continued to fight against many amateurs without breaking the losing blader's bay. Ishiyama notices Bird and challenges him to a battle, but after many battles, he has clearly exceeded his limits, and he looks thoughtful, as if something is wrong with him... Before long, he has his own bey and starts doing strange things...! Then, an unexpected person appears...! ?
episodes.title: The End of Persistence

episodes.synopsis: It's time to let the Shuffle Battle Fest commence! As both active and retired players are brought back to battle within mixed teams, viewers are eager to watch the opening match between unexpected bladers..!
episodes.title: The King and the Phoenix

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Kamen X and Pan begins. King talks about his encounter with the members of Zooganic, and says that he will realize that his friends are truly strong. How will Kamen Will Persona be able to perform well at the Shuffle Battle Festival and collect votes? ? In the final match of each team, the unexpected Blader finally appears! How will the 4X mascot AI, Ichigo-chan, fight? ?
episodes.title: Mask and Meat Buns

episodes.synopsis: On the second day of the Shuffle Battle Festival, a battle begins between the team "Multi-sama and I", to which Multi belongs, and the team "Otokogoma". Zonamos, who appeared in the first battle, proposes a mysterious Bey battle that he is good at! Toguro was reluctant to accept Nazotoki, but was pushed along by the excitement at the venue and decided to accept. In the ensuing battle, the man who is closely related to Yuni and Persona clash! ! What will be the outcome of these two battles...?
episodes.title: Riddles and Pop

episodes.synopsis: The battle between teams “Multi-sama and I” and “Otokogoma” has finally reached the final battle! The third battle is a showdown between Multi and Cadover, who also operates the X Tower! Maruti will appear on stage with a flashy performance and liven up the venue wearing idol costumes. Persona is conscious of gaining votes as a team, and Multi works for her friends to stand out, but Cadover starts bringing up stories about Multi when she was working as a one-person team even before the battle…! ?
episodes.title: My Teammates

episodes.synopsis: On the final day of the Shuffle Battle Fest, the team Bird belongs to, ``Class Visit'', will be participating. Due to the success of EX and Multi, votes are gathering for Persona, but they still haven't reached the number one spot in the team vote and need more appeal! After receiving advice, Bird switches to a customized launcher and takes on the battle with his new partner. Will Bird, who has prepared to the fullest, be able to perform well in this event and gather votes for Persona?
episodes.title: New Partner

episodes.synopsis: Meiden will be competing in the final battle for Bird's team, "Class Visit." Meiden was once a professional blader on a team that was expected to reach the top of the X Tower, but due to certain circumstances, he retired from active duty. The audience, who knew of his past achievements, are excited by Meiden's appearance. Before the battle, Meiden says something cryptic while holding his Bey. What is his intention in participating in this Shuffle Battle Fest...?! And so the event ends, and the curtains rise on another battle.
episodes.title: Our Promise

episodes.synopsis: While Ex and Bird are helping out at Komaba Sushi, Nanairo Shiguru, a member of the X Tower champion team, suddenly visits the store. Shiguru doesn't acknowledge the abilities of the other members except Persona Ex, and asks Ex if he's not going back to Pendragon, but Ex suggests that Shiguru battle Bird. Then Multi appears, and an unexpected relationship between them is revealed...! Can Persona prove the strength of their team to Shiguru?
episodes.title: A Rainbow Guest

episodes.synopsis: The All-Star Battle begins, a battle between those chosen by vote in the Shuffle Battle Fest! Persona's opponent is the impromptu team "Dreams," formed from the top three individual votes. One of the team members, Blader Manjuu Quinn, said to be a living legend, changes the battle format to a knockout tournament! The first blader, Bird, faces off against the super popular Beytuber Pakkun. What he pulls out is the same Bey as Bird...?!
episodes.title: The Dream Contest

episodes.synopsis: Multi is Persona's second blader who will face Pakkun, who won the first match of the All-Star Battle. Although he is a genius Beycrafter, Multi is quietly angry at Pakkun for using a Bird's Bey that was copied in a way that is unbecoming of a professional blader in the first match...! As confusion and criticism grow in the audience as they get closer to the truth about the Bey copy, Queen of the Beasts declares that the match will continue...!
episodes.title: Bladership

episodes.synopsis: Dreams' second Blader is Jyura Rex, known as the Undefeated Killer. He is known for his ferocity, and is overwhelmingly popular with fans looking for thrilling battles. The crowd erupts in cheers as Rex appears! From start to finish, Rex keeps jumping around and rampaging, repeating unpredictable onslaughts, forcing the Personas into a difficult battle. Bird and Multi are worried about Masked X in this battle where they don't know what's going to happen, but Masked X, who approaches the battle as usual, uses an unexpected strategy!?
episodes.title: Unpredictable

episodes.synopsis: The crowd erupts in cheers as the final battle decides whether Queen of the Beasts, who holds a record of 9,999 wins and 9 losses, will achieve her 10,000th victory, or whether Kamen X will break his undefeated record!
episodes.title: Return of the Queen

episodes.synopsis: The match was decided in a fierce clash between the Ten Thousand Beasts Queen, who was able to parry and nullify the opponent's attacks, and Masked X, who unleashed an unknown extreme dash.
episodes.title: The Greatest Blader

episodes.synopsis: Suddenly, Bird is challenged to a battle by a mysterious Masked Y. Masked Y continues to appear throughout X City, challenging the professional bladers that Masked X has fought to battles.
episodes.title: The Other Mask

episodes.synopsis: Following Masked Y, Masked Z appears, hunting down professional Bladers.
episodes.title: The Three Masks

episodes.synopsis: Z challenges X to a battle, but suddenly stops the battle and leaves.
episodes.title: XYZ

episodes.synopsis: Since his professional debut, Pendragon has been winning consecutive games, steadily climbing to the top.
episodes.title: Pendragon, Back Then

episodes.synopsis: As Bird worries about which Bey to use in the final battle, Multi begins to tell him about his past. No matter how hard he tries, he can't beat Shiguru with his Beyblade...
episodes.title: Family, Back Then

episodes.synopsis: A blader with dreams takes his first steps into X City. Although he performs as well as an amateur, the wall to become a professional is high and steep.
episodes.title: You, Back Then

episodes.synopsis: Just before the summit showdown, Bird is given a day off to rest and get away from his Beys, so he and X return to their hometown.
episodes.title: Time Off

episodes.synopsis: Finally, the summit decisive battle approaching tomorrow. With the thoughts for the actual performance, each spends the night the night... On the day of the greeting, Persona was surrounded by the press.
episodes.title: Battle at the Top

episodes.synopsis: In the first battle of the Summit Showdown, Shiguru and Multi face off.
episodes.title: The Nana-iro Showdown

episodes.synopsis: While Z and Bird were in high spirits, it was Ryugu Chrome who stepped up as the second blader. In response, X stepped forward as well.
episodes.title: Something Xtraordinary

episodes.synopsis: The head-on collision between the two Extreme Dashes was so powerful that it caused a crack in the Doranbuster.
episodes.title: The Two Xs

episodes.synopsis: The final battle of the summit showdown has finally come.
episodes.title: The Most Fun Ever

episodes.synopsis: After the Summit Battle, Persona vows to reach the top once again!
episodes.title: Restart

episodes.synopsis: Zooganic and Yggdrasil are strong candidates to challenge for the title match. However, Burn, who has refused to play against any other team, seems to have a plan...?
episodes.title: Signs of a New Era

episodes.synopsis: Senior Director Gigatani won't allow Pendragon to compete in the official match without Chrome.
episodes.title: Path of Resolve

episodes.synopsis: In response to Burn's request to try out the Phoenix Ladder, Ishiyama visits Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals.
episodes.title: Advance Bey Timeshift

episodes.synopsis: Shiroboshi Tenka suddenly appears at Komaba Sushi. He comes with the intention of having a bey battle with Masked X, but Masked X himself is not there.
episodes.title: Star Plot

episodes.synopsis: Finally, Persona's next match has been decided! When they head to X Tower without knowing the details, three teams have been called: Persona, Yggdrasil, and Zooganic.
episodes.title: Tri-Blader Battle

episodes.synopsis: Multi, Pan, and Zonamos were chosen as the second bladers for the triple battle.
episodes.title: Triple Battle

episodes.synopsis: The third bladers are Mask S, King and Burn! A heated battle ensues, and who will initiate the fight...?! And from B4, the new stadium will be unveiled for the first time in the world!
episodes.title: Blader S

episodes.synopsis: Convinced that we are entering a new era, Burn, Zonamos, and Yuni come to Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals' research lab on an isolated island. The sudden visitor seems to know the details of Mask S...?
episodes.title: Multi-Colored Trial

episodes.synopsis: Mask X readily accepts Tenka's condition that he will listen to his orders if he wins the battle, and they battle in the Double Extreme Stadium that he had prepared!
episodes.title: Invincible

episodes.synopsis: A special lesson taught by my teacher, Mr. Megaoka. Although confused, Maruti gradually remembers the basics of Baycraft...
episodes.title: The Prestigious Bey Academy

episodes.synopsis: To train in baycraft, Multi visits Animal Castle, home to the Ten Thousand Beasts. Multi is overwhelmed by the warm hospitality shown to her by King and Quinn's family.
episodes.title: The Manju Clan

episodes.synopsis: Multi, who is working hard on his Beycraft, takes a break and has a Bey battle with Joca. What advice did Joca give Multi?
episodes.title: The Shapeless Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Bird tells Tenka how he got started with Beyblade. His reaction when he first got the chance to play with a Beyblade was in stark contrast to how he is now...!?
episodes.title: First Flight

episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa is afraid of winning, but Bird yells at him to give it his all! The reason why Bird aims to become a professional blader is now revealed!
episodes.title: Something Captivating

episodes.synopsis: Masked X and Bird visit Pakkun for some intensive training. The next day, a disturbing video is posted... Meanwhile, Masked X wants to introduce his master to Bird and Tenka. Who is that master...?!
episodes.title: Silver Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Ginrou invites Ex to join him in a fight to protect the world from the underground gang. Ex's future will depend on a triple battle with Tenka! What will the outcome be?
episodes.title: Light and Dark

episodes.synopsis: Ginrou and his group arrive at an abandoned warehouse and begin battling the underground pros, with the condition that if they win, they will be able to take Pakkun home!
episodes.title: Shadowy Underground

episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the exhibition match! Just as Ciel is beginning to walk his own path to becoming the strongest, Blade appears suddenly in front of him...
episodes.title: Dread Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Omega hands Chrome a Bey with forbidden power! He witnesses the power of the Demon Dragon with his own eyes... What path will Chrome choose...?
episodes.title: To That Place

episodes.synopsis: The promotional event for the new stadium has begun! Bird goes to check out the identity of the ghost he saw on the security camera, but what awaits him...?
episodes.title: Labyrinth of Riddles and Terror

episodes.synopsis: At Tenka's request, Persona decides to join the duel for a win, but he notices a familiar face among his opponents! Persona's first match begins!
episodes.title: The Star Battle

episodes.synopsis: Persona vs. Gordius, a showdown between leaders and Karla! Bird is reminded of the curse that was placed on Rayu some time ago...!
episodes.title: Cursed

episodes.synopsis: When Rayu tries to put a curse on him that he cannot win, Multi shows off his new bey and smiles fearlessly. How will the battle between the knight and the ghost end?
episodes.title: Return of the Knight

episodes.synopsis: What strategy will Tenka use against Iwao, who boasts a high winning rate?! As the battle nears its end, with both of their stamina depleted, the situation changes dramatically!
episodes.title: White Nova

episodes.synopsis: Ekusu reunites with Khrome at the street battle arena. Ekusu is excited to fight Khrome again, but...
episodes.title: Blue Dragon and Dread Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Toguro and Pan visit Animal Castle to try customizing their bays. What is Quinn's true purpose in sending them out?
episodes.title: Customization

episodes.synopsis:
1-1. I'm Lum the Notorious!
This episode opens with a baseball game and Ataru getting hit with a left field flyball. Ataru is soon escorted home and discovers he's been chosen to fight an invading alien force's champion in a 10-day game of tag. If he loses, the aliens will invade. But if he wins, the aliens will go home. Ataru isn't at all willing to play tag until he sees the alien's champion: the beautiful Lum.
1-2. It's Raining Oil All Over Town
This episode opens with Ataru friends Megane and Lum's Stormtroopers at school who are watching films of the tag game. In this episode, a space taxi gives Ataru a ride home by accident and the fee is...too much. Since Ataru cannot pay, the space Taxi Collection Agency starts stealing all the oil in the world.
episodes.title: Il personaggio di un`altra galassia - Lamù deve tornare sulla terra

episodes.synopsis:
2-1. Space Mail Arrival of Ten-chan!
This is the first episode with Jariten, Lum's cousin. Jariten arrives in a giant peach and he and Ataru are enemies at once.
2-2. Mrs. Swallow and Mrs. Penguin
This episode opens with Lum putting on makeup to go meet Darling at school. A swallow swallows some food Jariten gives it and it grows such that it looks like a penguin. It's appearance in school is just the start of a full day of panic.
episodes.title: Ten, il bambino dello spazio / Una rondine e un pinguino

episodes.synopsis:
3-1. The Metamorphic Handsome Man Rei is Here!
This show features the first appearance of Rei, Lum's former fiance. This episode opens with Ataru in his room watching a storm, and Lum trying to coax him to bed. Shinobu meets Rei and brings him to Ataru's house. After a lot of arguing, Rei challenges Ataru to a duel for Lum.
3-2.Drop Dead, You Lady-Killer!
Ataru, Megane, and friends are going to a Gyudon restaurant for lunch and are quite shocked to see Rei munching down food like a black hole. During the rest of the episode, Rei is chasing Lum, Ataru and friends and as the chase goes on, the chaos grows on.
episodes.title: Rei, il mostro della città - Guai per un dongiovanni

episodes.synopsis:
4-1. Kintaro of the Autumn Sky
First episode with Kintaro, the vicious little boy with the pet flying bear and the red haired alien nanny. Lum and Jariten meet Kintaro inside a wind carp, and Kintaro tells them he's was looking for his nanny in the carp. Ataru, Shinobu, Lum, and Jariten try to help Kintaro find his nanny by asking around.
4-2. Live Vigorously!
Kintaro's nanny, with Ataru's help takes the alien children on a tour of Earth and a Earth child's school. Ataru tells the myth of the real Kintaro who grew up in the wild and slew a demon. So Kintaro decide to live up to his name.
episodes.title: Il bambino nell`aquilone - Il senso della vita

episodes.synopsis:
6-1. Love Triangle Black Hole
Ataru is phoning Shinobu in order to make plans for a date, when Lum interrupts and get's Shinobu mad at Ataru. Ataru throws Lum out and spends the rest of the episode trying to contact Shinobu. But Lum is persistent and uses a ray to jam the phone lines. But this ray also has the side affect of making a plane and a helicopter vanish.
6-2. Hey Hey, It's a Little Demon
Walking home from school, Ataru is assaulted by a group of black cats and gets a nasty bump on the head. At midnight, he is using two mirrors to look at the bump, when a little demon pops out of the mirror. The demon proves to be too much for Ataru and Mr. Moroboshi, so they get Cherry to exorcise it.
episodes.title: Sakura, bellezza misteriosa - Un terribile virus

episodes.synopsis:
7-1. The Scary Electric Shock!
Cherry gives Ataru some yellow ribbons which when tied to her horns, negate Lum's powers. In order to coax Lum into wearing them, Ataru has to put on a big charade of really loving her.
7-2. The Doll of Ill Will
After an odd loss of control of his body after dinner, Ataru finds out Lum has some clay for making voodoo dolls. Ataru takes full advantage of the situation until Lum make a doll of Shinobu, and Ataru tries to get it away from Lum.
episodes.title: Il triangolo dell`amore - Un piccolo demonio

episodes.synopsis:
8-1. Neptune Beyond the Closet
First appearance of Oyuki, Lum friend and queen of Neptune. Oyuki also has incredible ice powers. Megane and friends visit while Shinobu is nursing Ataru, who has a cold; and they discover a gate to Neptune in Ataru closet. By accident, they go through this gate and arrive on Neptune to be greeted by Lum and Oyuki.
8-2. The Confusing Dinosaur Age
While Ataru is flying an ultra-light, with Lum and Jariten tagging along, Kintaro crashes into him. With the help of Lum's electric shock, the crash send them all back in time to the dinosaur age.
episodes.title: Elettroshocks - Bamboline voodoo

episodes.synopsis:
9-1. Sleeping Beauty Princess Kurama
First episode with Kurama, the karas-tengu princess. On a field trip, Ataru and friends accidentally meet a karas-tengu who takes Ataru to marry Kurama. Kurama then tries to reform Ataru to be her perfect husband.
9-2 Athletic Woman Hell!
Kurama uses a weird dimensional door to try and cure Ataru of his lechery. Inside the door, Ataru faces hostile versions of the girls he loves.
episodes.title: Avventure su Nettuno - L`invidia degli uomini

episodes.synopsis:
10. Pitter-Patter Christmas Eve
Megane and Lum's Stormtroopers set up a plot to embarrass Ataru and get Lum to leave him at the same time. They set up a date who will make a fool of Ataru, but Lum finds out and twists things around.
episodes.title: Come diventare una donna - L`inferno delle atlete

episodes.synopsis:
11. Ataru Genji Visits Heinkyo
First appearance of Mendo, the rich noble; but it is not until episode 27 that he really does anything. Mendo tells a tale about ancient Japan featuring the normal cast in a slightly different alien invasion story. The aliens this time, all look like a bunch odd barbarians, except for a pretty girl and her young boy cousin.
episodes.title: Un Natale mozzafiato

episodes.synopsis:
13-1. Hawaiian Swimsuit Thief
Ataru, Lum, Shinobu, Sakura, Megane, Cherry, and others are staying at a beachside resort. During the day, an octopus is stealing peoples swimsuits, but it appears to look like Cherry is doing it. At the end, they find the octopus and beat him up.
13-2 Full Course from Hell
Still at the resort, the group meets some maniac who is having an all-you-can-eat contest. Sakura reveals the secret of her figure to be a diet pill called ""Beauty Foods."" But we really know the real reason is Sakura can just plain eat like a whale, and we see her do so as she beats Ataru and Cherry in the contest and clean the maniac of all his food.
episodes.title: Il playboy Ataru - La vittoria degli orchi

episodes.synopsis:
14-1. Mendo Arrives With Trouble!
Mendo returns for a formal introduction on his first day at school. He and Ataru have a duel for presidency of the class which ends in a tie. So they have a duel with cannons, which Ataru wins with help from Lum.
14-2. Constellation-Go-Round
Lum's computer tells her that Mendo is really the best choice for her lover, so she brings a set of constellation scales to school and weight Ataru versus Mendo in a series of test in the scales. At the end, the scales break and we see the class as constellations.
episodes.title: I due pretendenti - L`esempio di Wakamaru

episodes.synopsis:
15-1. Great Kiss War
First appearance of Benten, Lum's best friend the goddess. Lum takes Ataru to another planet to help in a battle against Benten's family. The battle consists of catching stones in bowls on a giant set of scales. Ataru starts playing with Benten and ends up messing up the entire game.
15-2. The Benten Corps' Return
Match Benten and her girl biker friends come to Earth for another round of fun. Ataru sides up with Benten again, and Lum recruits Jariten and some people dressed as demons.
episodes.title: Avventura alle Hawaii - L`abbuffata infernale

episodes.synopsis:
16-1. Oh, Lonely Teacher! First appearance of Kuribayashi Sensei
Ataru and Kuribayashi are enemies from the very start. Then Lum shows up and Kuribayashi falls in love. Finally Lum goes out with Kuribayashi in hopes on lightening his spirits.
16-2. Terrible Inspection Day
On a day when students mothers come to school, Mrs. Mendo and Lum's mother get into a dispute and Mrs. Moroboshi acts as judge by setting up a roulette game.
episodes.title: Il duello - Test di compatibilità

episodes.synopsis:
17-1. Fourth Dimensional Camera
Mendo bring an antique camera to school that sends Ataru off into other worlds. Lum manages to find him through a class room window that had been stuck for years.
17-2. Demonic Jogging
Every morning, Ataru goes jogging early to see girls. On the way to school, Ataru breaks the fall of an attempted suicide as he was grabbing for a 100-yen coin below her. Ataru and Mendo get into a dispute over who is more noble and end up playing a game of tennis.
episodes.title: La grande battaglia - Match di ritorno

episodes.synopsis:
18-1. Girl's Day! Ran-chan's Arrival
First appearance of Ran, Lum's childhood friend. During a small celebration at the Moroboshi house, a little doll enchants Ataru to follow it to Ran. Ran tries to kiss Ataru to drain his youth, but Lum shows up.
18-2 Ran-chan's Introduction
Ran invites Lum, Ataru, and Ten over for cookies and tea, but her real plot is to suck Ataru's youth. Ran makes a double of Ataru and tries switching them, but she gets confused and loses the real Ataru.
episodes.title: Le mie lezioni private - Brividi di terrore

episodes.synopsis:
20-1. Sleeping in Class on a Wonderful Spring Day
During math class, Kuribayashi and all the students fall asleep, save for Ataru and Mendo. Lum arrives and finds out that a tiny old man and girl are responsible for this magic. The tiny girl then uses some more magic to have a party with Lum, Ataru, and Mendo; until the principal arrives with some parents.
20-2. Peach Blossom Poetry Contest
Lum, Mendo, Shinobu, Ran, Ten, Sakura, and Cherry all are in a blossom orchard for some traditional reason. Ataru is in the blossom orchard for a picnic. Cherry's chanting summons some sort of woman spirit, whom Ataru runs off and meets with a giant.
episodes.title: Fotografia a 4 dimensioni - Un percorso pericoloso

episodes.synopsis:
21-1. Duel! Ataru vs. Ataru
Ataru eats a lollipop Lum gave him and gets a mouth burn. Running off, he finds Cherry and a weird melon, which Ataru eats to cool his mouth. The melon causes Ataru to split into two Ataru's, one polite and the other casual. The two continue to fight all day.
21-2. Waking to a Nightmare
Sleeping in class, Ataru has weird dreams which he relates a little of as he occasionally talks in his sleep. Annoyed, his classmates wake him and a dream demon comes out from Ataru's sleep.
episodes.title: La vendetta di Ran - Un invito amichevole

episodes.synopsis:
19-1. Diary of Sorrowful Tomorrows
Lum acquire's Ataru's diary that has written in events that will happen throughout the day. Ataru tries to use it to his advantage, but the records in the diary are not quite how they first read; making use of puns or ambiguous statements.
19-2. Whose is this Child?
Mendo finds an alien child in his locker and goes through great lengths to hide it from everyone. Later after everyone has found out, a whole mob of these alien children arrive, just for Mendo.
episodes.title: Il diario di Ataru - Il neonato dello spazio
